receipts.receiptSource: Original Receipt in 'A Shilling Cookery for The People' by Alexis Soyer (Soyer 1845);
receipts.receiptText: 388. Ginger Cake.- Half a pound of sugar, half a pound of batter, one ounce and a half of ground ginger, six eggs, beat well, stirring one pound and a half of flour, and add as much milk, a little warm, as will make a nice stiff dough for bread; bake in pan; it will take two hours.
